title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore Auditorium on 1966-11-19

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard capture of a high‑energy Pigpen‑driven show with scorching Cream Puff War, Smokestack Lightning and an epic Midnight Hour.
ai_review.review: The recording is a generally clear soundboard source with only faint hiss and occasional crackle, though the Dancin' in the Streets jam is cut short. Musically the concert bursts with up‑tempo blues and psychedelic jams – Pigpen dominates five songs, Jerry delivers crisp, soaring solos, and highlights include Cream Puff War, Smokestack Lightning, King Bee and an 18‑minute Midnight Hour.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly praise the performance (many 5‑star) while noting minor recording defects; weighted combination yields a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Slight background hiss and occasional snap/crackle/pops; otherwise clear SBD. No radio interruptions but Dancin' in the Streets cut off ~8 min into Jerry's solo.

poor_songs: Dancing in the Streets (cut off early)
show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑tempo, Pigpen‑heavy set with bluesy jams and tight playing; seamless transitions especially from Smokestack into King Bee, maintaining a relentless, upbeat momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Amazing guitar tone and solos (especially on Cream Puff War and Dancin' in the Streets); crisp front‑of‑stage presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill's drumming noted as driving and energetic.
